records.body: Does the API support pagination for the accounts endpoint, or do we need to fetch everything at once?

records.subject: Re: API pagination
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for the question. List endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Systems
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for setting up Harbor Systems on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, kickoff held 09-04 [calendar:f7ba67fb] with no reply to welcome email [email:bc9ba5d4], no project, no invites, no tickets. Pro plan and attended kickoff show some intent, but zero product activity after a week makes unaided milestone in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: Following up on our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for making time for the kickoff last week. I wanted to check in as you get Harbor Systems set up in Wrenfield.

A good first step is creating a project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk through that first project with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Nadia
